entities.name: Q5KXX3 pantothenate synthetase
observations: Reviewed Geobacillus kaustophilus protein; input sequence is an exact 300-residue match to Q5KXX3.
Annotated EC 6.3.2.1; catalyzes ATP-dependent condensation of (R)-pantoate and beta-alanine via a pantoyl-adenylate intermediate.

entities.name: Pantothenate synthesis
observations: (R)-Pantoate + beta-alanine + ATP = (R)-pantothenate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:10912.
